name: Proxy 12
definition: Identification of a proxy appointed to represent a party authorised to vote at a shareholders meeting and proxy vote.

PersonDetails.name: Person Details
PersonDetails.definition: Person, other than the chairman of the meeting, assigned by the security holder as the proxy.

ProxyAppointment1Rule.definition: If ProxyType is DISC (Discretionary) or HLDR (SecurityHolder), then PersonDetails must be present.
